correctness.rationale: For each arm c-u_i-v_i, only v_i distinguishes vertex u_i from edge u_iv_i, so every mixed resolver contains all q leaves. Leaf-distance vectors for c, u_i, v_i, cu_i and u_iv_i have respectively all 2; 1 at i / 3 elsewhere; 0 at i / 4 elsewhere; 1 at i / 2 elsewhere; 0 at i / 3 elsewhere. They are distinct even across arms. Leaves therefore resolve but do not dominate c. Adding c or exactly one u_i dominates; any minimum must be one of these q+1 additions. Independent brute enumeration of every vertex subset through q=5 confirmed counts q+1 and no smaller solution. No finite enumeration is relied on for arbitrary q.
